scientific_integrity: The hypergeometric expectation identity is established background, not claimed original; the claim concerns the sharp two-peak census boundary and all-size structural contrasts. An exact 66-profile finite proof and independent direct subset counting are supplied. Similar claims could exist under occupancy or urn language; independent originality review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp minimal census and unique exceptional profile proved only through eight individuals; symbolic all-size non-double-peak contrasts cover equal abundances and abundances at most two. Uniform finite-population sampling without replacement, fixed census and exact detection only. No assertion for larger-census classification, stochastic singleton sample paths, replacement sampling or empirical frequency of these profiles.
title: Eight individuals are the sharp boundary for two peaks in expected singleton counts
